partners.mechanism_chain: SGCD (HGNC:10607) —DISRUPTS→ dystroglycan complex assembly (GO:0035566); dystroglycan complex assembly (GO:0035566) —LEADS_TO→ Dilated cardiomyopathy (HP:0001643); HSPG2 (HGNC:4942) —DISRUPTS→ collagen fibril organization (GO:0030199); collagen fibril organization (GO:0030199) —LEADS_TO→ Myotonia (HP:0003455); collagen fibril organization (GO:0030199) —LEADS_TO→ Dwarfism (HP:0001510). Loss of function in SGCD disrupts the dystroglycan complex assembly, leading to dilated cardiomyopathy. partners.mechanism_chain: ACTB (HGNC:86) —DISRUPTS→ Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal neuronal development (HP:0001263); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036) —LEADS_TO→ Ptosis (HP:0000508); SGCD (HGNC:10407) —DISRUPTS→ Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036); Actin cytoskeleton organization (GO:0030036) —LEADS_TO→ Cardiomyopathy (HP:0011675).
